svg.title: Knotted self-expanders: a trefoil with three ends
svg.desc: Original topology schematic based on Mramor and Wang, Theorem 1.1 and Corollary 3.2. A trefoil tube is punctured three times and continued into three open annular ends. Not a computed self-expander.

g.text: Knotted self-expanders: a trefoil with three ends
Mramor–Wang · genus 1, three ends · topology schematic
A two-dimensional surface, with visible over / under crossings
The colored openings are display cuts through three noncompact annular ends.
The actual expander has asymptotically conical ends; their shape is not computed here.
Rotate and zoom in the reader. The schematic is not a numerical solution of the expander PDE.
